digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and behavioral-test shard enforcement
propositions: Historical whole-file mutant counts are stale (814 vs 491 in signing.py); enforcing old ceilings blocks work while accepting all survivors normalizes defects

Shard enforcement modes (advisory/ratchet/strict) must gate mutation verdicts differently: advisory runs head only and reports nonblocking findings; ratchet compares fresh base/head and preserves unchanged legacy outcomes; strict requires all mutants killed or individually fingerprinted
Selector must map changed source/test/support files and infrastructure changes to their shards, preserve rename sides, report unmatched tests, and fail on unresolved refs or empty diffs

Per-shard matrix jobs must use fresh isolated archives with no cached mutation verdicts, 30-minute job timeout, Python 3.12, pinned mutmut 3.7.0, max-children=1, and always-published structured evidence
Shard promotion to ratchet requires three stable pilot runs under 24 minutes; promotion to strict requires remediation or individual review of all non-killed legacy outcomes
